mapper.sql: j.id, j.name, j.skill_id, j.question_template, j.output_path, j.enabled, j.created_by, j.created_at, j.updated_at, j.metric_id, m.code AS metric_code, m.name AS metric_name, s.name AS skill_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job (name, skill_id, question_template, output_path, enabled, created_by, metric_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{skillId}, #{questionTemplate}, #{outputPath}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{metricId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.name = #{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job SET name=#{name}, skill_id=#{skillId}, question_template=#{questionTemplate}, output_path=#{outputPath}, enabled=#{enabled}, metric_id=#{metricId}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.metric_id = #{metricId} AND j.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
mapper.sql: id, job_id, trigger_type, status, conversation_id, resolved_output_path, md_file_written, md_file_exists, error_msg, started_at, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job_execution (job_id, trigger_type, status, conversation_id, resolved_output_path, md_file_written, md_file_exists, error_msg, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{conversationId}, #{resolvedOutputPath}, #{mdFileWritten}, #{mdFileExists}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status=#{status}, conversation_id=#{conversationId}, resolved_output_path=#{resolvedOutputPath}, md_file_written=#{mdFileWritten}, md_file_exists=#{mdFileExists}, error_msg=#{errorMsg}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = '应用重启中断：进程退出时仍在运行', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), completed_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING')
mapper.sql: id, job_id, execution_id, request_type, status, trigger_type, sender_name, recipient_summary, content_type, content, file_name, file_url, error_msg, requested_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job_notification (job_id, execution_id, request_type, status, trigger_type, sender_name, recipient_summary, content_type, content, file_name, file_url, error_msg, requested_at, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{executionId}, #{requestType}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{senderName}, #{recipientSummary}, #{contentType}, #{content}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{errorMsg}, #{requestedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job_notification SET status = 'SENDING', started_at = #{startedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill_job_notification SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
